content.comment_body: Hello, I'm new here and would appreciate some assistance. I'm able to monitor various variables (inputs, outputs, and markers) without issues, and the configuration appears correct, especially since the 'writable' option is enabled. However, when attempting to modify a VB bit (for example, VB1.1) using a button, nothing happens—the bit isn't activated or deactivated. I'm not sure why this occurs, but it's specifically a problem with this functionality. I've tried different interfaces and tools, including [product_name] Designer, [product_name] Writer, and [product_name] Monitor, but still see no change. I've attached the [product_name] program and [product_name] Monitor files. I was considering purchasing the license for this program, but without this feature working, I'm hesitant. Thank you all for your assistance! Best regards, [user_name]
I forgot to mention the setup: - Hardware: [product_name] [article_no] (12/24RCE) - Software: [product_name] [version_no] & [product_name] Monitor Multi Version: [version_no]

analysis.insight_summary: The user encounters difficulties setting or resetting VB bits through button actions within the monitoring tool, although general monitoring of inputs and outputs operates as expected. The issue persists across different tools and interfaces, leading to concerns about the reliability of the writable function and influencing the user's decision about purchasing a program license.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to be able to reliably write and modify VB bits using button controls in the monitoring tool, with the writable functionality of the device working as intended.
